description: Read-only research leads transcribed from the pinned public PGMFI P28 map. No stock-ROM hash, writable calibration, or checksum algorithm is asserted.
revisionScope: Only the code base called 304stock.bin by the cited PGMFI page; exact market, transmission, label, and baseline hash are unresolved.

sources.title: Archived PGMFI Library.P28 ROM/RAM map
sources.scope: The page explicitly says 304stock.bin is assumed for the ROM map.
sources.notes: Community documentation (TWiki r1.8, 2005-07-26), not an OEM specification; no baseline hash or reproducible test record is published.

sources.title: Archived PGMFI OBD1 8-bit low-cam RPM conversion discussion
sources.scope: Linked by the P28 page from the 0x6543 VTEC crossover lead.
sources.notes: Presents non-identical integer formulations and an explicit accuracy dispute; it is not an implementable encoding contract.

sources.title: Archived PGMFI DisableVtecVSSCheckP28 discussion
sources.scope: Community control-flow notes linked from the P28 VTEC VSS-check row.
sources.notes: Research lead only; not an editor, static-analysis, emulator, bench, or vehicle validation record.

parameters.description: The PGMFI map labels ROM offset 0x60E6 as a one-byte VTEC enable and claims 0xFF enables while 0x00 disables.
parameters.revisionScope: PGMFI P28 map assuming 304stock.bin only; no baseline hash established.
parameters.notes: Hex offset 0x60E6. Engineering range is deliberately unbounded because no numeric engineering conversion is asserted. Confirm every code reference and controlled editor cases before enabling any write.

parameters.description: The PGMFI map labels ROM offset 0x1292 as a one-byte VTEC coolant check and claims 0x44 enables while 0xFF disables.
parameters.revisionScope: PGMFI P28 map assuming 304stock.bin only; no baseline hash established.
parameters.notes: Hex offset 0x1292. The linked listing places 0x44 as an immediate operand in an ECT comparison, so this may be a threshold-byte bypass rather than a Boolean setting. No conversion is implemented.

parameters.description: The PGMFI map labels ROM offset 0x60FA as a one-byte VTEC VSS check and claims 0x00 enables while 0xFF disables.
parameters.revisionScope: PGMFI P28 map assuming 304stock.bin only; no baseline hash established.
parameters.notes: Hex offset 0x60FA. A bypass lead is not a safety recommendation. Confirm complete control-flow effects and editor normalization before any write is considered.

parameters.description: The PGMFI map labels 0x6542 through 0x6549 as crossover bytes and tentatively singles out 0x6543.
parameters.revisionScope: PGMFI P28 map assuming 304stock.bin only; no baseline hash established.
parameters.notes: Hex offset 0x6543. The linked conversion page contains conflicting integer formulations and an explicit accuracy dispute. Resolve with three-value Crome/HTS cases, rounding analysis, and static references; do not treat nearby 0x6542-0x6549 bytes as interchangeable.

tables.description: The PGMFI map labels 10 bytes at 0x7000 as the low-cam mBar scale.
tables.revisionScope: PGMFI P28 map assuming 304stock.bin only; no baseline hash established.
tables.notes: Hex offset 0x7000. The 1x10 representation is an opaque byte vector matching the published byte count; it does not assert table geometry, ordering, or a pressure conversion.

checksum.notes: The PGMFI map only labels a six-byte checksum jump routine at 0x2BAD and suggests a bypass patch. It does not identify stored checksum bytes, covered ranges, or an algorithm. HondaEcu must not apply that bypass; output remains not flash-ready.
